layout_and_spacing.marketing_page: Mode A: Tetris Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Asymmetric bento grid for Hero.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard: Mode B: Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4. Dense, 1px borders, tight padding.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 for glassmorphic containers.

landing_page.description: High-converting, enterprise-grade aesthetic with dark mode and sleek bento-grid layouts.
sections: Hero: Bento grid overlapping panels. Left side: Value prop (Instrument Serif). Right side: Animated 'AI thinking' mock.
Feature Showcase: Asymmetrical grid highlighting Autonomous Lead Engine, Pipeline, etc.
Social Proof: High-end company logos on dark background.
Pricing: 3 tiers, enterprise tier highlighted with Tracing Beam border.
CTA: Large section leading to Beta Onboarding.

command_center_dashboard.description: Live 'Command Center' visualizing AI-driven revenue activities.
command_center_dashboard.layout: Dense 4-column grid. Left rail navigation. Top row: Key Metrics with Animated Number Tickers. Main: Live AI Activity Feed.

agent_status_indicators.scanning: Cyan dot with radar scanning sweep (Framer Motion).
agent_status_indicators.thinking: Amber glow with rapid breathing opacity.

autonomous_lead_engine.visuals: Dark table/list with 'Scanning Beams' (moving linear gradients) indicating live processing. Lead score visualizations (progress bars in Cyan/Amber).

pipeline_automation.description: Visual kanban board showing AI-managed deals.
pipeline_automation.visuals: Glassmorphic columns, tight gaps. Cards have 1px borders. Highlight deals actively being 'worked on' by AI with a pulsing border.

beta_onboarding.description: Interactive section to onboard and see AI generate targets.
beta_onboarding.flow: Multi-step terminal-like form -> 'AI processing' screen with simulated terminal logs -> Reveals 10 high-value target cards.

image_urls.description: Abstract bokeh lights with fiber optics for landing page background or dashboard accent
3D abstract geometric structure with gold lines and black polygons for the Beta Onboarding processing state

instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: All interactive/informational elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='login-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.motion: Use Framer Motion for micro-interactions: hover states, agent status pulsing dots, scanning sweeps, and animated number tickers.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-React for techy, precise UI iconography.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import Geist Mono and Instrument Serif via Google Fonts or standard imports. Do NOT use Inter or standard sans-serif.
instructions_to_main_agent.glassmorphism: Ensure heavy use of backdrop-blur-xl (16-24px) combined with bg-black/40 and 1px white/10 border.
instructions_to_main_agent.noise: Add a global fixed noise div overlay using the provided SVG filter snippet to give the cinematic, expensive $1M/mo feel.
instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, Shadcn (customized to remove generic styling).
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Force dark mode. Remove light mode toggle.
